svg.title: F-070 physical frame and transport scopes
svg.desc: The constrained 28-coordinate frame, a visual distinction between raw MSD and centered covariance, and the exact sector-identity scopes.
svg.text: Physical frame, transport, and restricted equalities
The 28 stored coordinates form a redundant frame; physical states obey one=1 and uu_xx+uu_yy=1.
P, V, PV preserve the trace residual.
Theta, PTheta, VTheta, PVTheta restore it.
At M=2, Pe=3, rho=5: rank/nullity P 26/2; PTheta 27/1.
Raw MSD: E|r|^2 includes mean-drift contribution.
Never infer centered-covariance equality from raw-MSD equality.
Exact sector identities and contracted-observable degeneracy
PV / V, PTheta / Theta, and PVTheta / VTheta: complete internal (v,u) sector is identical.
Position reset nevertheless changes spatial transport to localization.
PV/PVTheta: equal Tr(S)=E|v|^2, Tr(C)=E[r dot v], and Tr(R)=E|r|^2.
This is a contracted-observable degeneracy only; centered traces differ for Pe>0 and component/orientation records separate throughout Pe>=0.
